summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Equinor ASA (NYSE: EQNR) announcing an ex-dividend date for its fourth quarter 2025 cash dividend. The filing states that shares trade ex-dividend on May 15, 2026, with a dividend amount of $0.39 per share in USD. There is no M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, rights offering, capital return program, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation event. The announcement is a routine disclosure of a dividend ex-date, published under Norwegian continuing obligations and corresponding to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 8.01 dividend disclosure. Role is issuer of the dividend. Confidence is high as the content is purely a dividend timing notice.
